categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and corrects Port Control Protocol / NAT-PMP port forwarding logic in `pcp.cpp` that affects node inbound reachability.
categories.rationale: Fixes an offset and width bug when parsing NAT-PMP fallback result codes in `pcp.cpp`. Evaluating a single byte at offset 3 instead of a 16-bit big-endian value at offset 2 per RFC 6886 caused codes such as 0x0101 to be falsely treated as `UNSUPP_VERSION`.
